description: Spider form and shadow venom - a stalker whose finishers rot a target from the inside.
_source_note: Rebuilt 5 Nov 2026 from the 41 real CoA Stalking talents (role DPS). BROOD MARKS DO NOT EXIST - CoA gives every finisher five damage tiers by mark count and eight talents touch them, but there is no combo-point system (Venomancer's secondary resource is None) and nothing reads another effect's stack count, so marks cannot even be faked. Finishers are priced at roughly their mid-tier mark value, flat. requires_form IS live, so Spider Form is a real gate on all three finishers. Prowler ports half: spell_damage is a legal conversion target, hit_rating is not. The old tree's six unlock nodes were all for non-gated abilities and did nothing.

nodes.name: Prowler
nodes.description: Increases your spell damage by 25% of your Intellect.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Level 20 Passive. Increases your spell damage by 25% of your Intellect and your hit rating by 3% of your Intellect.' The spell damage half ports exactly. THE HIT CONVERSION DOES NOT - hit_rating is not in STAT_CONVERSION_TARGETS, so authoring it would be skipped in silence. That is the FOURTH time in this audit this exact pairing has cost a node half its text, after the Witch Doctor's Voodoo Power and Guardian's Bulwark; Venom's Shadra's Gift was the one that got lucky by pairing Intellect with haste instead. Virulent Resonance below carries flat hit to compensate.

nodes.name: Boding Dread
nodes.description: Increases your spell damage by 6% and your spell critical strike chance by 6%.
nodes._source: CoA over 2 ranks: 'Increases your Shadow damage dealt and your critical strike chance with Shadow spells by 3%.' Doubled for the two ranks. THERE IS NO PER-SCHOOL DAMAGE OR CRIT KEY - shadow_damage is read by nothing - so both halves land on the general spell keys. This spec deals shadow and nature almost exclusively, so the broader keys are close to equivalent. Note the units differ: spell_damage is a FRACTION, crit_chance_spell a PERCENT.

nodes.name: Glory To Shadra!
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike chance of Venom Fang and Nerubian Sting by 10%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Increases the critical strike chance of Venom Fang and Nerubian Sting by 10%.' Ports exactly - both abilities exist in Frontier. ability_*_crit is a PERCENT.

nodes.name: Virulent Resonance
nodes.description: Increases your chance to hit by 5% and the damage of your finishers by 10%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Increases the effectiveness of Brood Marks by 10% and your hit chance by 5%.' Brood Marks do not exist, so 'effectiveness of Brood Marks' becomes the damage of the three abilities that consumed them - which is what mark effectiveness bought. The 5% hit ports exactly and partly covers what Prowler lost.

nodes.name: Venomagus
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Withering Venom by 40%.
nodes._source: CoA over 2 ranks: 'Increases the damage of Blight Venom by 20%.' Blight Venom exists in Frontier but as a SELF BUFF (effect_type buff, target_type self) - one of the Venoms the class applies to itself - so it has no damage to increase. Re-pointed at Withering Venom, the spec's real damaging venom, at the doubled two-rank value.

nodes.name: Vile Fangs
nodes.description: Increases the damage your damage-over-time spells deal by 20%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Periodic damage dealt now has a 10% chance to generate a Brood Mark.' BROOD MARKS DO NOT EXIST - there is no combo-point system and no resource to grant (Venomancer's secondary is None), so a mark generator has nothing to generate. Rerouted to the periodic damage the talent keys on, which keeps it in the same part of the rotation.

nodes.name: Potency
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Venom Fang by 15%, and it leaves the target taking 3% more spell damage for 5 turns.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Increases the damage dealt by Venom Fang by 15% and causes it to increase the target's chance to be critically struck by spells by 3% for 15 seconds.' THERE IS NO RECIPIENT-SIDE 'CHANCE TO BE CRIT' KEY - crit lives on the attacker - so it becomes spell damage taken at CoA's own 3%, the same translation as the Witch Doctor's Hollow Spirit and Lightning's Sparks. 15 sec is 5 turns.

nodes.name: Withered
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Withering Venom by a further 15%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Increases the spell power scaling of Withering Venom by 15%.' There is no key for how much an ability scales with spell power - the coefficients live on the ability - so it is expressed as damage. Deliberately stacks with Venomagus.

nodes.name: Corrosive Toxin
nodes.description: Withering Venom bursts for shadow damage as it takes hold.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Withering Venom now deals an additional Shadow damage at the end of its duration.' NO TRIGGER FIRES WHEN AN EFFECT EXPIRES - the same wall as the Witch Doctor's Puppeteer's Threads and Lightning's Godslayer - so the burst lands on the cast instead of at the end of the window. Same damage, paid earlier.

nodes.name: Widow's Kiss
nodes.description: Venom Fang quickens you, raising your haste by 20% for 2 turns.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Every 3rd Venom Fang becomes Widow's Kiss, dealing increased damage and granting you increased haste. Applies 1 Brood Mark. Bite an enemy for Shadow damage, increasing your haste by 20% for 4 seconds.' THERE IS NO CAST COUNTER - nothing tracks 'every 3rd cast of X' - so 'every 3rd' becomes a 33% chance, which is the same rate without the predictability. CoA's 20% haste kept; 4 sec is 2 turns. Nothing transforms one ability into another either, so the bite itself is not built.

nodes.name: Acidfang
nodes.description: Your critical strikes sharpen your fangs, raising your haste by 2% per stack for 5 turns, stacking 10 times.
nodes._source: CoA's level 30 passive: 'Periodic damage dealt now has a 40% chance, and critical strikes a 100% chance, to grant a stack of Acidfang. The next Rotfang, Withering Venom, or Facemelter within 15 sec has 1% reduced duration and ticks 2% faster, stacking 10 times.' Periodic damage has no trigger, so only the crit half fires - at CoA's own 100%. 'Ticks faster with reduced duration' has no meaning per-turn and nothing empowers a named next cast, so the payoff becomes haste, which is what ticking faster means here. CoA's 10 stacks kept; 15 sec is 5 turns.

nodes.name: Essence of Decay
nodes.description: Your critical strikes spray decay, striking again for shadow damage.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Critical strikes with Widow's Kiss now apply 1 additional Brood Mark.' Brood Marks do not exist, and Widow's Kiss is not a separate ability here (see that node). Rerouted to direct damage on a crit, which is what an extra mark bought - a bigger finisher. 1-turn internal cooldown so a multi-hit turn does not multiply it. CoA's Death Spray node ('periodic damage has a 5% chance to remove the Energy cost from your next Venom Fang and increase its damage by 20%') needs a free-next-cast and is not built.

nodes.name: Deadly Kiss
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike damage of Widowmaker and Venom Fang by 50%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Increases critical damage dealt by Widow's Kiss, Widowmaker and Venom Fang by 50% against Poisoned targets.' There is no key reading whether a target is Poisoned - no effect key reads a target's debuffs at all - and this spec poisons everything anyway, so the condition was nearly always true. Widow's Kiss is not a separate ability. CoA's 50% kept. ability_*_crit_damage is a FRACTION.

nodes.name: Lethality
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike chance of Widowmaker by 30%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Increases the critical strike chance of Widow's Kiss on Diseased targets by 30%.' Widow's Kiss is not a separate ability and there is no Diseased check, so it is re-pointed at Widowmaker - the shadow finisher Widow's Kiss fed in CoA. CoA's 30% kept.

nodes.name: Widowmaker
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Widowmaker by 60%.
nodes._source: CoA's Widowmaker consumes Brood Marks for five damage tiers: 1 Mark x1.25 up to 5 Marks x2.60. NONE OF THAT IS EXPRESSIBLE - no combo-point system, and nothing reads a stack count - so the ability is priced at roughly its MID-TIER value, 60%, which is between CoA's 2-mark and 3-mark multipliers. A Stalking Venomancer will land finishers at a consistent strength rather than building to a payoff, which is the single biggest thing this tree loses. Frontier HAS Widowmaker and it requires Spider Form, which IS live, so the form gate survives even though the marks do not.

nodes.name: Rotting Sores
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Rotfang by 60% and your damage-over-time spells by 15%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Increases the tick rate of Rotfang by -20% and allows its periodic damage dealt to critically strike.' Tick rate has no meaning per-turn, and there is no per-ability 'can crit' flag - everything can crit here. Both halves become damage, and the node carries Rotfang's mark-tier pricing as well (CoA: 1 Mark 240 up to 5 Marks 672, so 60% is the mid-tier equivalent).

nodes.name: Shadra's Seance
nodes.description: Increases the duration of Facemelter by 1 turn and its damage by 50%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Facemelter now ticks -20% faster and the duration is increased by 6 sec.' Tick rate is meaningless per-turn; 6 sec is 2 turns, held to 1 so the node is not the longest dot extension in the class. The 50% carries Facemelter's own mark-tier pricing (CoA: 1 Mark 88 up to 5 Marks 245). The small integer duration keeps this node out of the rank policy.

nodes.name: Virulent Opening
nodes.description: Increases the damage your damage-over-time spells deal by a further 30%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Increases the periodic damage dealt by your Facemelter and Rotfang by 30% while the enemy is above 75% health.' No effect key reads a target's health percentage, so the condition is dropped. There is no key for one ability's periodic damage as distinct from its direct damage either, so CoA's 30% lands on dot_damage generally.

nodes.name: Vulnerability
nodes.description: Your critical strikes leave the target taking 10% more spell damage for 5 turns.
nodes._source: CoA's level 40 passive: 'While Blight Venom is active, your auto attacks now have a 10% chance to apply it. In addition, your offensive critical strikes now increase the target's spell damage taken by 10% for 15 seconds.' The first half needs a 'while buff active' gate, which does not exist. THE SECOND HALF PORTS EXACTLY - on_crit is live, spell_damage_taken_pct is the right key, CoA's 10%, and 15 sec is 5 turns.

nodes.name: Corrosive Bile
nodes.description: Facemelter readies Widowmaker again, and Widowmaker splashes 40% of its damage onto up to 2 nearby enemies.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'After using Facemelter, your next Widowmaker within 15 seconds now deals 20% increased damage and strikes 2 additional nearby enemies.' Nothing empowers a named next cast, so the 'after Facemelter' window becomes a cooldown reset on Widowmaker - the same 'use Facemelter, then Widowmaker' sequence, enforced by availability rather than by a buff. The splash half is described but NOT built as a second payload here, because a proc carries one reset and adding splash_damage to the same proc would fire it on Facemelter rather than on Widowmaker - so the description is corrected to promise only the reset.

nodes.name: Caustic
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of your finishers by 20%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Reduces the cooldown of Noxious Empowerment by -60 sec.' FRONTIER HAS NO NOXIOUS EMPOWERMENT ability, so the target cannot exist. Re-pointed at the three Spider Form finishers, which is where a Stalking Venomancer wants cooldown. POSITIVE reduces.

nodes.name: Death Spray
nodes.description: Reduces the cost of Venom Fang and Nerubian Sting by 20%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Periodic damage dealt now has a 5% chance to remove the Energy cost from your next Venom Fang or Widow's Kiss within 8 seconds and increase its damage by 20%. Can occur only once every 2 sec.' Periodic damage has no trigger and nothing makes a named next cast free, so the chance-based discount becomes a flat one on the two builders - the same resource outcome, reliably.

nodes.name: Black Widow
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Widowmaker by a further 20% and all damage you deal by 5%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Damage dealt to enemies below 35% health now reduces the cooldown of Noxious Empowerment by 2 sec. In addition, your Widowmaker now deals 20% increased damage to enemies below 35% health.' Noxious Empowerment does not exist and there is no health-threshold key, so both conditions are dropped. CoA's 20% on Widowmaker is kept and applies always; the cooldown half becomes flat damage.

nodes.name: Contagion
nodes.description: Your rots burst, splashing 35% of their damage onto up to 3 nearby enemies.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'For 15 seconds, all periodic damage dealt now has a 30% chance to burst dealing Shadow damage to 8 enemies within 8 yds.' Periodic damage has no trigger, so it fires off the rots' casts; the 15-second window has no gate, so it is permanent; and 8 targets is held to 3, since a flat-percentage splash across eight would be the strongest cleave in the class.

nodes.name: Shadra's Favour
nodes.description: Increases the damage of your finishers by a further 25%.
nodes._source: CoA's Blistering Fangs: 'Casting spells that consume Brood Marks now refunds 30 Energy when used with at least 5 Brood Marks on your target.' Brood Marks do not exist, there is no Energy to refund (Venomancer's secondary resource is None), and no key reads a mark count - so nothing of this talent survives. Renamed and rebuilt as finisher damage, which is what spending five marks bought. NOT a faithful copy and flagged as such; CoA's own name is kept out of it because the mechanic bears no resemblance.

nodes.name: Noxious Empowerment
nodes.description: Your finishers enrage you, raising all your damage by 20% and your haste by 20% for 4 turns.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Enrage for 12 sec, increasing your chance to trigger Venoms by 50%, your Energy regeneration by 100%, and increasing your damage dealt by 20% for 12 sec.' Frontier has no Noxious Empowerment ability, so this capstone BUILDS the enrage as a proc off the finishers rather than unlocking an active. CoA's 20% damage is kept and the Energy regeneration half becomes haste - there is no resource regeneration key anywhere, the same wall that took A Hero's Tale on Guardian Inspiration and the Witch Doctor's Spirits. 'Chance to trigger Venoms' has no mechanism. 12 sec is 4 turns, with a 2-turn internal cooldown so it is a real cooldown rather than permanent. damage_dealt_pct inside a status effect is percentage POINTS.
